title: Plugin Hardening + Licensing
description: Harden the PRISM plugin for production deployment. Implement comprehensive error handling for all HTTP calls, AC API failures, and edge cases. Build offline mode with cached physics data for air-gapped shops. Implement RS256 JWT license verification with machine fingerprint binding. Compile Python to .pyd via Cython for source code protection. Build signed .zip distribution with auto-update checking. Obfuscate HTML/JS panel code.

forge_triple.hook: hm-plugin:license-enforcement-gate — BUILT (blocks plugin activation without valid license)
forge_triple.action: hypermill_plugin:validate_license — BUILT (RS256 JWT verification with machine fingerprint)

sessions.title: Error Handling + Offline Mode
sessions.intent: Implement comprehensive error handling for all plugin operations and build offline mode with cached physics data for air-gapped shops.

units.title: Comprehensive Error Handling
units.description: Implement error handling for all failure modes: PRISM server unreachable (show cached data or graceful degradation), AC API failures (catch COM exceptions, retry, user notification), malformed responses (schema validation on all HTTP responses), timeout handling (configurable per-action timeouts), and user-facing error messages (non-technical, actionable). Add error telemetry reporting to PRISM server when online.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Server unreachable shows 'PRISM Offline' badge with last-cached data timestamp
AC API COM exceptions caught with retry (3x) and user notification on persistent failure
All HTTP responses validated against expected schema before processing

units.title: Offline Mode + Physics Cache
units.description: Build offline mode for air-gapped shops. Cache last-known-good physics data (material properties, tool catalog subset, machine limits) locally in encrypted SQLite. Offline mode provides: speed/feed recommendations from cached Kienzle parameters, tool search against cached catalog subset (last 500 used tools), quality predictions from cached models. Auto-sync when connection restored. Cache encrypted with AES-256.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Offline S/F recommendations use cached Kienzle kc1.1 values for all 6 ISO material groups
Cached tool catalog includes last 500 tools used with full geometry data
Auto-sync updates cache within 30 seconds of connection restoration

sessions.exit_gate: All error paths handled gracefully + offline mode provides S/F with cached data | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: License Verification + Code Protection
sessions.intent: Implement RS256 JWT license verification with machine fingerprint binding, compile Python to .pyd via Cython, obfuscate HTML/JS, and build the signed distribution package.

units.title: RS256 License Verification + Machine Fingerprint
units.description: Implement RS256 JWT license verification: plugin checks license JWT on startup against embedded public key. JWT claims include: tier (pro/enterprise), expiry, machine_fingerprint (SHA-256 of CPU ID + disk serial + MAC address). License validated locally (no phone-home required after initial activation). Grace period: 14 days after expiry before hard lock. License file stored in AC plugin directory.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: RS256 JWT verification passes with valid license and fails with expired/tampered license
Machine fingerprint SHA-256 matches current hardware (CPU ID + disk serial + MAC)
14-day grace period allows operation after expiry with daily warning notification

units.title: Cython Compilation + Signed Distribution
units.description: Compile all Python plugin modules to .pyd via Cython (Windows) or .so (Linux) for source code protection. Obfuscate HTML/JS panel code (minify + variable mangling + string encryption). Build signed .zip distribution: manifest.json (version, checksum, signature), compiled .pyd modules, obfuscated panels, embedded public key. Add auto-update checker (compares version against PRISM server, notifies user of available updates).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: All .py files compiled to .pyd with no readable Python source in distribution
HTML/JS panels minified and obfuscated with variable mangling applied
Signed .zip passes integrity verification (SHA-256 checksum + RS256 signature)

sessions.exit_gate: License blocks unlicensed use + .pyd compiled + signed .zip builds + auto-update works | omega_floor >= 0.90
